lines.text: The next morning...
Doctor Maria sits at her desk, staring into the distance.
A full glass of alcohol is in front of her. She hasn't drunk a drop.
Alcohol will not help with what is going to happen.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Is everything ready?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Yes. The Commander is safely on board the transport ship.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Good. I guess it'll be his last flight.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The transport ship's route is set.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Twenty minutes after the flight begins, move according to the plan.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Also, I've picked out a squad that's the least known in the Ark, but has the highest potential.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Their record paints them each out to be problematic in some way, but the CEOs of Elysion and Tetra seem to have a particular fondness for them.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'm not sure why, but they've got powerful backing, so it'll be safe. You won't stand out.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: They happen to be out on the surface, so the transport ship will head their way.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You and No. 7 are listed as reinforcements for their squad.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The rendezvous point and other information is inside the transport ship, so make sure you go over all of it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: What about the Commander?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: He's clean. Remember, he's on record as having just graduated from the academy yesterday.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: His cover is all prepared, so there won't be any problems.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: So long as Enikk doesn't get involved, that is.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: The supercomputer you mentioned.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah. That's the biggest obstacle we have to face.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... But I do have something in mind for it, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay. Thank you.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Are you sure you won't regret this?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: What about you, Doctor?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sure too.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Good. Now get going.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Sure. I'll head out now.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I'm sorry, Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Thank you, Doctor.
Marian turns and walks away.
Doctor Maria watches until she's out of sight.
Marian keeps going down the stairs.
She stops in front of a door.
She hesitates for a moment,
but soon opens the door and steps inside.
She enters the machine used for the "enhancement procedure."

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... My existence will be a risk too, won't it?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... If I'm being honest, yes.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Even more so than No. 7.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Being a Nikke means there's no shortage of ways to crack your head open.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: There's no shortage of trouble that could find its way to you.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The only thing you can do is to run and stay out of reach as much as possible.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... If they catch me, it'll be back to square one, huh?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: There is the option of using No. 7's Vapaus to erase your NIMPH.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It's meant to eradicate nanomachines, so it should be possible if you want to go that route.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: No, I don't want that.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I don't want everything erased.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: All Nikkes who get corrupted are disposed of, right? That's the Ark's rule, isn't it?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: They don't get examined, or their heads opened.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: They probably just get filed away as, "corrupted Nikke who was shot and killed."

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... That's... true, I guess...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No. No, no, no. That's not the move here.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: What would be the point? It'd be completely meaningless.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: But it's the only way to be sure.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You're supposed to live with No. 7!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That won't work. I'd still be a risk.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: As long as the Commander can live, I don't mind what happens to me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So it's okay.
Marian, finished with the "enhancement procedure," gets up.
She leaves the room and heads for the transport ship.
The ramp door opens and she walks in.
She sits down and looks at the Commander sleeping across from her.
She looks, and keeps looking.
Hoping that he'll go on to live a good life.
After confirming the transport ship's departure, Doctor Maria detachedly presses the enter key on her keyboard.
Alarms ring out from every corner.
Only then does Doctor Maria take a single sip from the glass on the desk.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... It's done.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Is the research facility under attack?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: All data in the research facility is currently being deleted.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: All of my backup files are being deleted as well.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you require assistance?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This is your doing, Doctor Maria.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are you ceasing production of the Queen and her companion?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are you throwing away humanity's future?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Have you given up on your own future?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The Queen, Liliweiss, all of it can go to hell.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Tell humanity to take responsibility for its own future. Leave us out of it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Also, my future was ruined a long time ago.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I cannot comprehend your behavior.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'm granting my daughter her wish.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You do not have a daughter.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I have a wonderful daughter. Her name's Marian.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No data exists for such an individual. I am unable to comprehend.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Do you remember No. 7?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No such data exists.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Oh, wonderful. It worked. It really worked.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Hahaha... How about that? Turns out I'm pretty amazing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Hear that, AI? In the end, you're nothing but a pile of data.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I inherited the knowledge of Doctor Alva, humanity's greatest genius.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Did you think I wouldn't be able to hack you? I'm the goddess of data.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I am not an ordinary AI, Doctor Maria.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will dispatch forces to the research facility.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: For what reason?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correction. Insufficient justification. Canceling deployment.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Who am I?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No data found on this individual.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Anomaly detected. Initiating emergency transfer of all current data pertaining to this situation to M.M.R.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Haha... Hahaha!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll wipe every last bit of it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The data here, the data you hold, the data you've scattered everywhere. All of it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: This place, me, Marian, No. 7...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No one in the entire world is going to know a thing about us.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I can't stop people from talking, but mere talk won't accomplish anything anyway.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Anomaly detected. Redirecting all resources to defend against hacking attempt.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm only erasing the data from here.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Consider yourself lucky. You may be a filthy AI, but you've been blessed with the ability to forget. You should be rejoicing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And while you're at it, my daughter and son-in-law have just set off on their first and last honeymoon.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Why don't you celebrate that, too?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Because I feel like it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Terminating communication. Initiating emergency defense processes.
With a beep, the line goes dead.
Doctor Maria catches her ragged breath.
She finishes the rest of her drink.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Good.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Doing what you want to do...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: actually feels really nice.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Doesn't it, Marian?
Marian doesn't take her eyes off the Commander.
After a long while, an alarm sounds.
It's time.
Marian squeezes her eyes shut.
She sends the signal as planned,
and immediately throws herself over the Commander.
*Kaboom!*
An explosion erupts inside the transport ship.
Marian holds the Commander tight,
and prays.
Please. Let luck be with us.
*Rumble, rumble*
The transport ship crashes.
Marian comes to.
This is clearly different from the place she saw hundreds of times before.
They crashed just as planned.
Now, since someone from the Ark may be watching,
she has to act the part.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: BA-01 down! BA-01 down!
